notes.title: Indie classic Super Hexagon gets a big free Neo update out now
notes.notes:
Super Hexagon, a true indie gem classic from Terry Cavanagh has a big update out now and it has also become Steam Deck Verified with it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/indie-classic-super-hexagon-gets-a-big-free-neo-update-out-now
